name: faq-section
title: FAQ Section
description: A page section for answering common product or purchase questions in native disclosure rows. It accepts a title, optional introduction, and question items with stable ids and React-node answers. Use it to make secondary details available without overwhelming the page; keep high-stakes terms and essential pricing information visible elsewhere rather than hiding them only inside disclosures.
docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Use unique ids for each question. Native disclosures are independent and allow multiple answers to remain open simultaneously.

meta.engineeringNotes: Uses the native details/summary disclosure pattern rather than recreating accordion state and keyboard semantics. It supports browser-native keyboard operation and independent open states, with no runtime dependency or forced single-open behavior. Answers remain React nodes so consumers can include links or structured details.
meta.motionNotes: The plus indicator rotates using the instant motion token only to reflect open state; the answer itself appears through the browser's native disclosure behavior. Under prefers-reduced-motion the indicator transition is disabled while its orientation and the answer state still communicate the change.
